title: Meeting Prep
description: Research attendees and relevant past messages, then prepare an agenda and briefing.

assignments.task: Research attendee companies and relevant documents.
Read relevant past email and calendar details.
Produce the meeting brief and proposed agenda.

fields.label: Meeting details
fields.help: Time, topic, attendees, companies and desired outcome.

fields.label: Past threads and sources
fields.help: Configured account IDs, public links or background notes.

instructions: Prepare a meeting brief from the supplied meeting details. Delegate attendee/company/document research to Researcher and relevant email/calendar reading to Comms. Produce a sourced attendee summary, agenda, questions and open decisions. Identify missing details. Do not contact attendees or edit the calendar.
prerequisites: Connect email/calendar accounts for past-message and event research, or supply meeting details.
approvalPoints: Read-only tools; no outgoing messages or calendar changes.
limitations: Run on demand or at a reviewed fixed schedule. A trigger relative to each meeting's start time is not available yet.
